start_ray_dashboard_job: start a RayDashboardJob actor to launch Grafana and Prometheus subprocesses for monitoring
get_ray_dashboard_status: get the current status of Grafana and Prometheus processes managed by the RayDashboardJob actor
cleanup_ray_dashboard_job: cleanup and terminate all Grafana and Prometheus subprocesses managed by the RayDashboardJob actor
update_ray_scrape_interval: update the Ray scrape interval in the Prometheus YAML configuration file
start_prometheus_subprocess: start a Prometheus subprocess with a custom config file and listen address
